title: Tahini Bao Bites
description: A fusion of Indian and Chinese flavors in these crispy bao bites filled with a creamy tahini filling. Perfect as a snack or appetizer.
instructions: 2. In a bowl, mix together tahini, Chinese Five-Spice Powder, and Garam Masala.
3. Add lemon juice to the bowl and mix until smooth.
4. Cut the bao into small squares and place them on a baking sheet.
5. Drizzle vegetable oil over the bao and sprinkle with a pinch of salt.
6. Bake for 10-12 minutes or until crispy.
7. Fill each bao square with the tahini mixture and serve immediately.
